title: The Authority No One Gave You
theme: Authority begins as an emergency claim, becomes a burden shared with strangers, and is judged by preparation, trust, and who survives its exercise.
emotionalQuestion: Will the summoned company obey because the Master is strong, cooperate because the settlement needs them, or decide that authority must be earned?

worldLaws.statement: A dead hero or Master cannot be restored by story direction or mission reward.
Retreat ends an attempt but preserves its bodily, social, and informational consequences.
A discovery may influence a later beat only through a living character who holds its evidence.
Optional expression and complications cannot replace a floor primary objective.
Only authored triggers and successful extraction can grant the fixed band rewards.

openingFacts: Hearth 01 is a walled settlement with no government and only the systems the Master has restored.
New summons arrive as adults without a shared history or automatic recognition of the Master.
The Endless Tower is the only known route to the First Ember and the power the settlement needs.

floors.narrativeJob: Establish the need and ask who may command.
floors.mechanicalJob: Introduce knowledge boundaries and the First Ember.
Require formation and a second capability.
Apply injury, scarcity, and retreat pressure.

floors.narrativeJob: Reveal the cost of what the company noticed.
floors.mechanicalJob: Test separation, preparation, and held information.

floors.narrativeJob: Judge authority by preparation and consequence.
floors.mechanicalJob: Pay off the Warden conflict and preserve aftermath.

voices.deliveryBrief: Deliver the fixed fact as an actionable company constraint; add no new event or order.

voices.deliveryBrief: Deliver the fixed fact as evidence to interpret; distinguish observation from inference.

finaleConstraints.summary: The company must confront and defeat the authored Foundry Warden.
Victory reveals that Hearth 01 was not the first settlement.
The relight core and archive fragment become canonical only through extraction.
